title: Keep optional image builders consistent with patched compiler pin

acceptance_criteria.description: Existing optional image commands accept current pinned compiler and preserve receipt, clean-source and no-push boundaries.
acceptance_criteria.required_evidence: Minimal pin-only changes, existing Python builder/selection tests and syntax/scope checks; existing service artifacts require later patched rebuild, no qualification relabeling.

evidence.command: Minimal four compiler-string/README updates; tooling8/proxy3/cannon2 tests and four Python syntax checks pass; scope reviewed.

handoff: Optional commands accept patched compiler; old image runtime security evidence is not renewed.
